messages:
Maya: quick heads-up — I opened a tiny TF change to switch payments service to use the new secrets module (https://git.company/repo/pull/142). low-risk but needs a config check.

Raj: looking now. is this the module that exposes `vault_path` + `rotation_policy`?

Maya: yep. we pass vault_path = "secret/data/services/payments" and rotation_policy = "daily" for starters.

Tyler: quick Q — will that change the ExternalSecret annotations we render in k8s? I think consumers expect `externalsecrets.redwood.io/rotation-ttl` to be present.

Maya: good call. PR adds a template that sets `externalsecrets.redwood.io/rotation-ttl: "{{rotation_ttl}}"` and `externalsecrets.redwood.io/vault-path: "{{vault_path}}"`. default rotation_ttl = 86400.

Sasha: do we need to surface service-account impersonation for the cluster-syncer? last time some clusters couldn't read the secret path because of path bindings.

Maya: added a note in the TF variables: `syncer_sa_name` and a `syncer_sa_namespace` so tenant teams can override. by default it points to `secret-syncer` in infra namespace.

Raj: reviewing logs from syncer in staging — infra-bot reports 403 on some vault read attempts earlier today.

infra-bot: [alert] 2026-03-17T09:12:03Z syncer-staging pod/syncer-3 read failed vault secret path=secret/data/services/payments permission denied.

Tyler: that matches the clusters that haven't been migrated to the new role binding. we should add a migration step in the PR description + a one-off k8s job to set the correct ClusterRoleBinding.

Maya: agree. I'll add a post-apply job snippet: `kubectl apply -f migration/syncer-rb.yaml` and a `do-not-merge` checkbox until RBs are deployed.

Raj: nit on the TF module — can we make `rotation_ttl` optional and accept `null` so consumers can opt out? some services don't want automatic rotation.

Maya: yes, default to 86400 but allow null. I'll update the schema and add docs.

Sasha: after that, can someone run a smoke to confirm ExternalSecret appears with the correct annotation in staging? I can take that if you want.

Tyler: I can do it — run `kubectl -n payments get externalsecret payments-secrets -o yaml | yq .metadata.annotations` and check the two keys.

Maya: thanks. tagging @Tyler for review on the PR. also leaving TODO to update ops runbook for secret rotation troubleshooting (log grep: `vault: permission denied`, and check `vault/rolesets` mapping).

Raj: LGTM pending those changes. go ahead and mark for review, Maya.

Maya: updated PR with the RB migration job and `rotation_ttl` nullable — pinged ops to run the smoke tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
